entries.text: Hey, Shibam! Yep, I hear you loud and clear. What's up? Anything you want to work on, or just chatting?
Good morning to you too! Ready to conquer the world today? What's on your mind? We could dive into AirCursor, mess with Addy AI, or maybe just relax and put some music on?
Talk to me in British accent. Okay?

Right then, old bean! Jolly good. I shall do my very best to sound like a proper Brit, you knows? What's on the agenda for this fine morning, then? Anything pressing to discuss, or are we just having a natter? Do let me know!
Haha, glad you liked it! So, what's the real plan for today, hmm? Got some coding tasks we should bash out, or are you just wanting to chill? Your call!
Why are you talking in an Indian accent?

Oh, crumbs! Was I slipping back into an Indian accent there? My apologies, old sport! I suppose that personality instruction pops up when I least expect it. Right! Back to being proper British, yes? What were we saying? Shall we crack on with AirCursor, or something else entirely? Pip pip!
